settings.heading: Why Cutting Foods Alone Isn't Enough
settings.text:
Gout starts when uric acid builds up faster than your kidneys can clear it. It forms sharp crystals in your joints, and that's what brings the swelling, stiffness and pain.

Diet only slows down new uric acid. What's already there keeps building, often for years, until a flare hits. Blomar works the other way: it supports your body in flushing uric acid out every day, so it has less chance to build up.
